Test Case Name: Verify Processing Status Tile Visibility and Status Icons
Description: Verify the Processing status tile is visible on the dashboard and displays correct icons for saved, for approval, and approved statuses.
Pre-conditions: A Writer user is logged in. Records exist in saved, for approval, and approved states.
Expected Result: The Processing status (Bearbeitungsstatus) tile is visible on the dashboard.

Step Description: Observe the tile content for a record in saved state.
Expected Result: The tile displays an entry with a save icon.

Step Description: Observe the tile content for a record in for approval state.
Expected Result: The tile displays an entry with a single orange tick icon.

Step Description: Observe the tile content for a record in approved state.
Expected Result: The tile displays an entry with a green double tick icon.

Step Description: Log out and log in as a Viewer user.
Expected Result: The Processing status tile is visible and displays the same status icons.

Step Description: Log out and log in as an Admin user.
Expected Result: The Processing status tile is visible and displays the same status icons.

Test Case Name: Verify Pop-up Display and Navigation to Original Mask
Description: Verify that clicking the tile opens a pop-up showing actions being processed and allows navigation to the original mask to continue the release process.
Pre-conditions: A Writer user is logged in. The Processing status tile shows at least one action.
Expected Result: The Processing status tile is visible.

Step Description: Click on the Processing status tile.
Expected Result: A pop-up appears showing details of the actions being processed.

Step Description: Click on a selectable area for a specific action within the pop-up.
Expected Result: The user is navigated to the original mask (Bearbeiten page) for that record.

Step Description: On the original mask, verify the Send for Approval button is enabled for a saved record.
Expected Result: The user can continue the release process from the original mask.

Test Case Name: Verify Tile and Pop-up with No Active Processes
Description: Verify system behavior when the Processing status tile is present but no actions are in saved, for approval, or approved state.
Pre-conditions: A user is logged in. No records are in a pending state.
Expected Result: The Processing status tile is visible.

Step Description: Observe the content of the tile.
Expected Result: [Needs Clarification] The tile should indicate no active processes.

Step Description: Click on the Processing status tile.
Observe the content of the pop-up.
Expected Result: [Needs Clarification] The pop-up should indicate no active processes.

Test Case Name: Verify Viewer Role Cannot Continue Release Process
Description: Verify that a Viewer user can see the tile and pop-up but cannot interact with the release process due to view-only restrictions.
Pre-conditions: A Viewer user is logged in. The Processing status pop-up is open with at least one action.
Step Description: From the pop-up, click the selectable area for an action.
Expected Result: The user is navigated to the original mask in view-only mode.

Step Description: On the original mask, observe available buttons and fields.
Expected Result: All fields are disabled. Only the Schliessen (Close) button is enabled. The user cannot continue the release process.
